q: By June 30, 2027, Samsung Electronics or SK hynix announces a decision to build a memory wafer fab in the United States (excluding packaging and foundry) in a regulatory filing or press release that specifies the site or the investment amount (conditional reviews, memorandums of understanding, and reports that a plan is under consideration do not count)
basis: On August 19, 2026, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said South Korean companies had no plans to invest in memory production in the United States. Building a fab in the United States costs about twice as much as in South Korea and takes more than five years to reach operation. Yet the commerce secretary has demanded either a 100 percent tariff on memory or production in the United States. There is a precedent: after the 1993 U.S. antidumping duties on South Korean DRAM, South Korean makers built DRAM plants in the United States, but the announcements took two to three years, and it has not been established that the duties caused the plants to be built. · AI and Chips issue
rs: Samsung Electronics or SK hynix regulatory filings (DART) or press releases
